# repair

Benchmarks of [`ordito.repair`](../api/ordito/repair.md) against every library that computes the same thing. Each chart shows the time of every library relative to ordito on CUDA (1x, in green): a longer bar took longer. The table under each chart lists every input the function was measured on. See [Benchmarks](index.md) for how to read and reproduce these numbers.

*Measured on GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 · CPU: Intel Xeon w7-2495X*

## Without a reference

No other library computes these, so they have no comparison. ordito (CUDA)'s median time on the largest input it was measured on:

| Function | Input | ordito (CUDA) |
|---|---|---|
| `remove_degenerate_and_non_manifold_faces` | sphere_med extra=1024 | 204.7 µs |
| `duplicate_vertex_inverse` | sphere_med epsilon=1e-06 | 265.0 µs |
| `remove_folded_faces` | saddle_graded | 166.2 µs |
| `remove_tunnels` | handles_64 | 6.10 ms |
